text.BIMx depune dosarul pentru obținerea lic: BIMx submits its application for a market operator licence – BIMx
text.17.06.2026, Chișinău – Bursa Internațion: 17.06.2026, Chișinău – On Tuesday, the Moldova International Stock Exchange (BIMx) submitted its application for a market operator licence to the National Commission for Financial Markets (CNPF). This step marks the start of the authorisation process, ahead of the operational launch expected in September 2026. {1}{2}BIMx aims to become the benchmark financial infrastructure of the Republic of Moldova and a platform for integration with European capital markets. The exchange mobilises private capital for economic development and supports the country's European financial integration.{3}BIMx's activity embeds the principles of sustainable development and inclusion, and is aligned with the National Capital Market Development Strategy 2025–2030 and the National Bank of Moldova's Sustainable Finance Roadmap.{4}{5}The application submitted to the CNPF includes the trading rules, operational procedures, internal policies, business plan and contracts with market infrastructure providers. The documents reflect an institutional and governance framework designed to meet the requirements of a modern capital market aligned with European standards.{6}{7}Throughout the preparation of the application, BIMx received specialist advice from ACI Partners (team led by Cristina Martin) and Dentons (team led by Loredana Chitu).{8}{9}The combined expertise of the two law firms, gained on complex capital market infrastructure development and regulatory projects in Romania and the Republic of Moldova, helped to structure a set of documents aligned with European best practice.{10}{11}The new exchange creates a transparent and predictable framework for all participants, through which companies, local public authorities and the state can raise capital, while investors gain access to new investment opportunities.
text.Veronica Arpintin, CEO BIMx, a declarat:: Veronica Arpintin, CEO of BIMx, said:
text.„Depunerea dosarului de licențiere este: "The submission of the licensing application is the result of an extraordinary effort by the BIMx Council and team. Following the Company's registration with the Public Services Agency (ASP) in December 2025 and the Competition Council's decision in February 2026 on the Exchange's compatibility with the competitive environment, a comprehensive set of rules and procedures was developed that will underpin the operation of the Exchange, delivered through the ARENA trading platform.{1}{2}This application reflects BIMx's commitment to building a financial infrastructure based on trust, transparency and accountability. We will offer companies in the Republic of Moldova access to new sources of financing, and investors a trusted framework for their decisions."
text.Alexandru Sonic, Președintele Consiliulu: Alexandru Sonic, Chairman of the BIMx Council, stated:
text.„Bursa este un element esențial pentru d: "The exchange is an essential element in the development of the capital market in Moldova. In its first years of operation, BIMx will benefit from the support of its strategic partner, the Bucharest Stock Exchange, and aims to list its first 2 – 3 issuers and attract at least 4 brokers.{1}{2}We are preparing the market through information sessions, training and technical support for brokers on the use of the trading platform. We are working with potential issuers to adapt their corporate governance policies and financial reporting standards. Our objective is to stimulate both supply and demand."
text.În perioada următoare, CNPF va evalua do: Over the coming period, the CNPF will assess the documentation submitted, while BIMx will continue its preparations for the operational launch expected at the end of September 2026. Interest from potential issuers has already been established, and the first issues are expected from 2026.{1}{2}The launch of BIMx represents a strategic step in the development of the Republic of Moldova's financial infrastructure and in bringing it closer to the standards and practices of European capital markets.{3}{4}BIMx has been established through a public-private partnership unprecedented in the Republic of Moldova, bringing together the following founders: the Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB), the Public Property Agency (APP), Donaris Vienna Insurance Group S.A., maib, Grawe Carat Asigurări S.A., Moldindconbank S.A., MK Kredit Company S.R.L., OTP Bank Moldova S.A., Moldcell S.A. and Premier Energy S.A. The total committed share capital is 3,000,000 EUR.

text.24.08.2026, Chișinău – Bursa Internațion: 24.08.2026, Chișinău – The Moldova International Stock Exchange (BIMx) announces that it has obtained a market operator licence and authorisations to administer and operate a regulated market and a multilateral trading facility. The decision was adopted by the National Commission for Financial Markets (CNPF) on 21 August 2026. The CNPF also confirmed the composition of the BIMx management bodies: Veronica Arpintin was confirmed as Chair of the Executive Body and Andrian Iastremschi as Vice-Chair of the Executive Body, each for a three-year term.
text.Licența și autorizațiile acordate creeaz: The licence and authorisations granted provide the legal framework required to organise and conduct transactions in financial instruments in accordance with the legislation in force.
text.Obținerea licenței survine într-un conte: The licence comes at a favourable time, as the Republic of Moldova accelerates its path towards EU accession. BIMx is aligned with the objectives set out in the National Capital Market Development Strategy 2025–2030, contributing directly to the creation of a functioning capital market.
text.Misiunea BIMx este de a mobiliza capital: BIMx's mission is to mobilise private capital for the sustainable economic development of the Republic of Moldova, providing a transparent, predictable and inclusive framework for all. BIMx will thus become a benchmark financial infrastructure for the Republic of Moldova and a platform for integration with international capital markets, recognised for operational excellence, sound corporate governance and its contribution to the region's economic prosperity.
text.Veronica Arpintin{1}, Președintele organ: Veronica Arpintin{1}, Chair of the BIMx Executive Body, said:
text.„{1}Setarea unei burse este rodul unui e: “{1}Setting up a stock exchange is the result of a joint effort by the shareholders, the team and the partners of BIMx – ACI Partners and Dentons Romania – who helped build an institutional and governance framework aligned with best practice{2}.”
text.Andrian Iastremschi{1}, Vicepreședintele: Andrian Iastremschi{1}, Vice-Chair of the BIMx Executive Body, added:
text.„{1}Împreună cu echipa BIMx, am creat o: “{1}Together with the BIMx team, we have created a fully functional operational infrastructure and configured the ARENA trading system for Moldova's capital market. This is the result of intensive work and a shared effort to build a modern, secure stock exchange aligned with European standards.{2}”
text.Alexandru Sonic{1}, Președintele Consili: Alexandru Sonic{1}, Chair of the BIMx Council, stated:
text.„{1}Confirmarea acționariatului și a str: “{1}The CNPF's confirmation of the BIMx shareholding and management structure strengthens an unprecedented public-private partnership. We remain committed to listing the first issuers and registering brokers in the coming period, with the strategic and technical support of the Bucharest Stock Exchange – a partner with strong international experience{2}.”
text.BIMx va continua pregătirile operațional: BIMx will continue its operational and technical preparations for the launch of the ARENA trading platform, scheduled for autumn 2026. Potential issuers have already shown clear interest, and the first issues are expected this year.
text.Activitatea operatorului de piață se va: The market operator's activities will be carried out under CNPF supervision to ensure the proper, transparent and efficient functioning of the capital market infrastructure.

text.Cadrul procedural prin care persoanele f: The procedural framework through which individuals designated by BIMx member brokers obtain exchange trader status and the right to operate in the trading system.
text.Agentul de bursă este persoana fizică ca: An exchange trader is an individual who enters orders and concludes transactions in the trading system of the Moldova International Stock Exchange, in the name and on behalf of a member broker of the Exchange. This status is obtained exclusively through the certification procedure organised by BIMx, which assesses both knowledge of the regulatory framework applicable to the capital market and the practical ability to use the ARENA platform.
text.Procedura este stabilită prin Regulament: The procedure is set out in the BIMx Regulation on the Certification of Exchange Traders and detailed in the Procedure for Organising the Theoretical and Technical Assessment, both approved by the BIMx Executive Body and available for consultation at the bottom of this page.
text.Cine poate deveni Agent de Bursă: Who can become an exchange trader
text.Calitatea de agent de bursă se poate dob: Exchange trader status may be obtained by any individual who meets all of the following conditions:
text.Este cetățean al Republicii Moldova sau,: Is a citizen of the Republic of Moldova or, in the case of foreign nationals, has the legal right to work in the Republic of Moldova
text.Nu se află în situații de incompatibilit: Is not in a situation of incompatibility or conflict of interest that would affect the proper performance of this role
text.Este angajată a unui broker membru al BI: Is employed by a BIMx member broker and has been designated by it for certification
text.Verificarea cunoștințelor profesionale n: The professional knowledge required to act as an exchange trader is assessed exclusively through the examination procedure laid down in the Regulation.
text.Procesul de atestare parcurge cinci etap: The certification process consists of five successive stages, from the broker's designation of the candidate to actual access to the trading system.
text.Desemnarea candidatului de către broker: Designation of the candidate by the broker
text.Calitatea de agent de bursă se dobândeșt: Exchange trader status is obtained exclusively on the proposal of a member broker of the Exchange. The employing broker designates the candidate by submitting a certification file containing the documents required by the Regulation, including the application for registration signed by the broker's legal representative, the declarations of compliance, the candidate's identity documents and other supporting documents. The file is submitted electronically, with a qualified electronic signature, to the official BIMx email address.
text.După confirmarea completitudinii dosarul: Once the application file has been confirmed as complete, BIMx schedules the examination session and notifies the broker and the candidate of the date, time and venue, in compliance with the notice period set out in the Regulation. Each session is organised for a single candidate, given the individual nature of the technical component, which requires the candidate to be directly supervised at a dedicated workstation. Together with confirmation of the booking, the candidate receives the preparatory materials: the detailed examination syllabus, sample questions for guidance and the ARENA Platform User Guide. The materials are for guidance only; passing the examination requires full knowledge of the applicable regulatory framework.
text.Examenul se desfășoară la sediul BIMx și: The examination is held at BIMx’s premises and comprises two consecutive components, both mandatory, with no compensation between them. The theoretical component tests knowledge of the applicable regulatory framework: the BIMx Rules on the Regulated Market, the BIMx Rules on the Multilateral Trading Facility, the provisions governing the operation of the Central Securities Depository insofar as they are relevant to the activity of an exchange trader, the operating principles of the capital market, order types, trading mechanisms, and the obligations of professional conduct, confidentiality and market abuse prevention. The technical component tests the candidate’s practical ability to use the ARENA platform in a test environment by performing specific tasks covering the entry, modification and cancellation of orders, the use of the order types provided for in the BIMx Rules, the interpretation of market information and compliance with security procedures for access and password management.
text.Rezultatul examenului nu se comunică pe: The examination result is not communicated on the spot at the end of the session. On the basis of the minutes of the session and the proposal made by the Listing and Operations Department, the BIMx Executive Body issues the Admission Decision, which identifies the candidates who have passed the examination and orders their admission as exchange traders. The Decision is the sole act concluding the certification procedure — no individual certificates or other additional documents are issued. The Decision is officially communicated to the employing broker, which is required to provide an extract of it to the certified candidate.
text.Alocarea codurilor de acces și autorizar: Allocation of access codes and authorisation to trade
text.În baza Deciziei de admitere, agentul at: On the basis of the Admission Decision, the certified trader receives an individual ARENA user code and an initial password, sent via a secure channel, and is entered in the Register of Exchange Traders maintained by BIMx. From that point, the trader may operate in the trading system on behalf of the broker, in compliance with the provisions on access security and credential management. BIMx notifies the CNPF of certified traders in accordance with the applicable regulations.
text.Regulamentul nu impune un număr maxim de: The Regulation does not impose a maximum number of examination attempts. A candidate who does not pass may submit a new certification application, with no restriction as to timing or frequency, provided that all the conditions set out in the Regulation are met and the fee for the new session is paid.
text.Taxa de examinare este prevăzută în Nome: The examination fee is set out in the BIMx Schedule of Fees and Commissions, approved by the CNPF and available in the dedicated section of the website. The fee is payable per examination session, including the initial session and any subsequent retake session.

text.Ședința de tranzacționare pe piețele adm: The trading session on the markets operated by the Moldova International Stock Exchange takes place every business day from 10:00 to 14:00, Moldova time.
text.Fiecare ședință parcurge, în ordine, urm: Each session passes through the following states, in order:
text.Se introduc, se modifică sau se retrag o: Orders are entered, modified or withdrawn in the system without trades being executed. The indicative opening price is calculated and displayed.
text.Se determină prețul de deschidere pe baz: The opening price is determined by the fixing algorithm, and trades are executed against the orders accumulated during Pre-open.
text.Tranzacționare continuă. Ordinele se exe: Continuous trading. Orders are executed on a price-time priority basis.
text.Se introduc, se modifică sau se retrag o: Orders are entered, modified or withdrawn, without execution, in preparation for the close. The indicative closing price is calculated.
text.Se determină prețul de închidere prin al: The closing price is determined by the fixing algorithm, and trades are executed.
text.Se pot încheia tranzacții exclusiv la pr: Trades may be executed only at the price resulting from the fixing algorithm.
text.Ședința este încheiată. Nu se acceptă or: The session has ended. No new orders are accepted.
text.Detaliile complete privind stările piețe: Full details on market states, the order types accepted in each state and the mechanisms for temporary trading halts are set out in the Exchange Rules on the Regulated Market (Title V) and the Exchange Rules on the Multilateral Trading Facility.
text.Ziua de tranzacționare este orice zi luc: A trading day is any business day in the Republic of Moldova. BIMx markets are closed on non-working days and on public holidays provided for in the Labour Code of the Republic of Moldova.
